visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women stand outdoors under an airport awning. The woman on the right holds the camera in a selfie position; she has long black hair with bangs and is wearing an unbuttoned white shirt over a magenta top. The woman on the left has brown hair in a ponytail and is wearing a light blue shirt over a dark pink top. They look directly at the lens, blinking and smiling slightly. The background shows a blue and white logo sign and distant airport staff in safety vests. (2) A rapid transition is executed as a hand reaches from the side of the frame toward the lens, effectively wiping across the camera view to create a seamless match cut. This physical movement momentarily obscures the background airport setting and the characters' faces to prepare the viewer for the scene change. (3) The scene shifts to a sunny beach environment. The same two women are now wearing vibrant bikinis—one in teal and the other in bright pink—paired with denim shorts. They have large decorative flowers tucked behind their ears. They smile broadly and strike poses against the backdrop of a blue ocean and white sandy shore under a bright, cloudy sky.
